title: The computed quotient and remainder satisfy the division specification
statement: For every natural a and every natural b: the pair (b / (a+1), b % (a+1)) -- Nat's computed quotient and remainder of b by the nonzero divisor a+1 -- satisfies the division-algorithm specification relating dividend, divisor, quotient and remainder.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.div_mod_exec : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> AxNat.divMod (AxNat.succ x0) x1 (AxNat.div x1 (AxNat.succ x0)) (AxNat.mod x1 (AxNat.succ x0))))

evidence.supports: Nat.div_mod_exec is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: test "$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- Nat.div_mod_exec 2>/dev/null | grep -Ec '^Nat\.div_mod_exec[[:space:]]')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check; the command both performs it and prints the admitted type, which is copied verbatim into formal.statement.
